speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and have noticed some abnormal findings during my initial observation. To begin narrowing down the cause, have you noticed any night sweats, persistent fever, or changes in your appetite alongside these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; your lack of fever or night sweats is noted. Given your age and the 5 kg weight loss with good appetite, I need to investigate potential malignancy or chronic infection. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count and request a peripheral blood smear. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
